message_to_myself: Session 3: Fixed the choppy streaming playback by replacing the <audio> element chunk-by-chunk approach with a Web Audio API AudioContext scheduler (useAudioScheduler) that pre-schedules decoded buffers on a sample-accurate timeline — zero gaps. Removed temp file disk I/O entirely, switched to BytesIO for prompt uploads. Wired generate_speech_streaming to delegate to the real StreamingPipeline (event-driven, CrossFadeBuffer, token-level chunking via chunk_tokens_punctuation). Fixed ONNX CPU path — AudioGenerator now detects OnnxModel vs PyTorch and routes accordingly. Added empty-token guards in generate/generate_cpu + try/catch with logging in the streaming loop. Built voice cloning persistence: VoiceStore saves encode_dict as .pt files in voices/, new voice blueprint (clone/list/delete), stream endpoint accepts voice_id to skip re-encoding. Frontend gets voice selector chips in VoiceSourceSection with save/delete. Ran full indexer benchmark — it's 3-10x more efficient than Grep/Glob for structural queries. Next: test voice cloning end-to-end, tune chunking for better streaming feel, the kernel-size-too-small error on very short chunks still needs a minimum token count guard.
